purpose: Repair quality-head training/calibration while freezing appearance and thresholds
features: Frozen v2 encoder; original surface head and surface temperature immutable. Quality heads use normalized pooled feature activations, final only or stages 3/8/12.
loss: Exact separate binary class/video-balanced full-batch cross entropy for each quality head; no appearance-biased mixed sampler.
selection: 29 original validation video groups split by fixed SHA into quality model-selection and disjoint calibration groups. Head checkpoints chosen separately by class/video-balanced NLL. Candidate chosen by equal-head selection NLL.
calibration: Positive-slope affine logit calibration with regularization on calibration groups only, per-video natural prevalence weighting; unconstrained sign flips forbidden. Compare pre/post calibration and quality false accepts.
testPolicy: Original 32-video test is exposed regression only; new fixed 16-video reserve unused for fitting/selection/calibration. Freeze final weights/script/protocol before test hand review and prediction. Never retune against either test.
deployment: Offline repair candidate; original anatomical qualification failure remains. No orientation fusion or phone deployment.
calibrationGuard: Reject affine calibration for a head if it increases false accepts on its held-out calibration negatives at the unchanged 0.8 threshold; use the balanced-trained raw head instead. Applies before opening/predicting fresh hand test inputs.
calibrationAddendum: First validation-only fit exposed 2 contact negatives vs 52 positives in the independent calibration split. Natural-prior affine fit collapsed contact slope to near zero and accepted both negatives. That proposal is rejected; do not turn majority prevalence into contact evidence. Preserve the complete original candidate run as a diagnostic and apply the explicit negative-protection guard to its unchanged trained heads.
